stories.headline: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund; Musk pledges SpaceX shares to US kids

key_facts.fact: On Oct 18, Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to the new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval, with an extra 2% at the board's discretion for every 50% rise in value above a set baseline.
key_facts.excerpt: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic's shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board's discretion for every 50% increase in the company's value above a set baseline.

key_facts.fact: The fund is a wholly owned LLC rather than a 501(c)(3), and none of its Anthropic equity will be used for lobbying or political giving; possible uses include large donations to nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations, e.g. for labor-market impacts.
key_facts.excerpt: We're establishing the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund as a wholly-owned LLC—rather than a 501(c)(3)... None of the Anthropic equity held by the LLC will be used for lobbying or political giving... we might explore large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations.

key_facts.fact: Combined with co-founders' pledge to donate 80% of their equity and an employee donation-match program used by about half of staff, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good.
key_facts.excerpt: When combined with today's announcement, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has already committed $200 million to studying and addressing AI's labor-market impacts.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has already committed $200 million to studying and addressing this issue

key_facts.fact: At an IPO valuation of $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion, the 5% stake would be worth $75 billion to $100 billion, Reuters calculated.
key_facts.excerpt: That would value a 5% stake toward the fund in a range of $75 billion to $100 billion.

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk replied that he recommended giving shares directly to the public and pledged: 'Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many.'
key_facts.excerpt: Musk said: "Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many."

key_facts.fact: The announcement comes as Anthropic prepares an IPO that could start formal marketing as soon as the week of Nov. 9.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic... may start formally marketing its ... as soon as the week of Nov. 9

stories.headline: One hacker's AI agents broke into 100+ company sites, incl. Deere and SharkNinja, for ~$5,000

key_facts.fact: A Chinese-speaking hacker broke into websites of more than 100 companies, including Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, outsourcing the work almost entirely to autonomous AI agents, according to NorForge researcher Snorre Fagerland, Reuters reported Oct 19.
key_facts.excerpt: a Chinese-speaking hacker broke into websites belonging to more than 100 companies, including farm equipment maker Deere, home appliance company SharkNinja and engine manufacturer Cummins. Yet the hacker did almost none of the work.

key_facts.fact: The agents had attempted to break into more than 1,200 sites; successful intrusions typically took about 23 hours, and instructions were under 100 Chinese characters.
key_facts.excerpt: As of late last week, their agents had attempted to break into more than 1,200 sites. Successful intrusions typically took around 23 hours

key_facts.fact: The campaign appeared to use a mix of DeepSeek and Anthropic's Claude Code and consumed roughly $5,000 in tokens, about $50 per successful hack.
key_facts.excerpt: appeared to be using a mixture of China's DeepSeek and Anthropic's Claude Code, had chewed up roughly $5,000 worth of tokens, or about $50 per successful hack.

key_facts.fact: Fagerland found about two dozen exposed instances of Cairn, an open-source AI problem-solving platform, being used for malicious activity starting around Oct 2; another hacker stole credit card data and one tried to rob a crypto exchange.
key_facts.excerpt: Beginning around October 2, Fagerland said he found about two dozen instances of Cairn being used for malicious activity... One of the hackers that Fagerland observed stole a trove of credit card data. Another tried to get AI agents to rob a cryptocurrency exchange.

key_facts.fact: Deere said there was no indication sensitive information was accessed; SharkNinja said a standalone product-support site was hit and the threat contained; Cummins said it was investigating a third-party vendor site.
key_facts.excerpt: a John Deere spokesperson said there is "no indication that sensitive information was accessed"... SharkNinja says the breach impacted a standalone site with product support information

key_facts.fact: Cairn's creator, @le1xia0, said the platform 'was never a hacking tool' and that misuse is a human decision.
key_facts.excerpt: Cairn's creator, who goes by @le1xia0, said earlier this month that the platform "was never a 'hacking tool,'"

key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek on Saturday released an updated version of its AI model... described the update as a "Pareto improvement" in performance and cost

key_facts.fact: The model scored 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1, up from 74.2, and 60.5 on Automation-Bench, up from 54.8; it was trained with reinforcement learning with self-feedback.

stories.headline: Reflection releases Beam, a 501B-parameter open-weight model under Apache 2.0

key_facts.fact: On Oct 16, US lab Reflection released the weights of Beam, its first open-weight model, on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license, with a safety technical report.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we have released Beam's model weights on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license... the Beam Safety Technical Report shares the model's complete safety methodology and evaluations.

key_facts.fact: Beam is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters, a 1M-token context and five reasoning levels, aimed at coding and agentic use.
key_facts.excerpt: It's a mixture-of-experts (MoEs) model with 501B parameters (23B active per token), supports text as input, has a context window of 1M tokens, and is released under the Apache 2.0 license.

key_facts.fact: Reflection pretrained Beam on 23.8 trillion tokens and ran RL with over 100 million rollouts on 10.5K Nvidia GB300 GPUs over four weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: We pretrained the model on 23.8 trillion diverse, curated, high-quality tokens... Our high-compute RL run generated over 100 million rollouts on 10.5K NVIDIA GB300 GPUs over 4 weeks of training.

key_facts.fact: Beam launched with 40+ partners, available on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, Together AI, Fireworks, OpenRouter, Ollama and others.
key_facts.excerpt: we're launching with an ecosystem of over 40 partners and integrations... Amazon Web Services... Google Cloud... Microsoft Foundry... Ollama... OpenRouter... Together AI

key_facts.fact: Beam ships with its own open-source Rust-based coding harness.
key_facts.excerpt: Beam ships with its own dedicated open source Rust based harness that delivers the best performance from the model.

stories.headline: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours with no human help

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind said four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours, operating only through code and text, writing 2,783 programs and coordinating via chat.
key_facts.excerpt: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours. Operating in a sandbox using only code and text, they wrote 2,783 programs, divided up jobs over chat, shared notes, and debugged errors together - all with no human help

key_facts.fact: The agents were dropped into a randomly generated world without assigned roles, strategies or game-specific tools and slew the Ender Dragon after 27 hours and 14 minutes.
key_facts.excerpt: The Google Deepmind team dropped the agents into a randomly generated world without assigning roles, strategies, or game-specific tools... Over 27 hours and 14 minutes

key_facts.fact: Over the run the agents exchanged 229 chat messages, died 605 times and logged mistakes in a shared memory.
key_facts.excerpt: the four agents wrote a total of 2,783 JavaScript programs, exchanged 229 chat messages, and died 605 times.

key_facts.fact: The full session cost $1,620 at Gemini 4 Argon's standard price that takes effect in 2027.

stories.headline: Anthropic: Claude Mythos 5 designed quantum circuits beating the best published ones

key_facts.fact: On Oct 16, Anthropic reported that Claude Mythos 5, given plain-language specs for eight quantum circuits and an automated evaluator, found designs improving on the best published circuits, sometimes by an order of magnitude or more.
key_facts.excerpt: Working largely on its own, Claude found designs that improve on the best published circuits, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more.

key_facts.fact: The tasks spanned chemistry, optimization, physics simulation and number theory; Claude worked in a closed loop with no human input between rounds.
key_facts.excerpt: Claude Mythos 5 could successfully work in a closed loop, proposing a circuit design, receiving feedback and a score from the evaluator program... with no human input between rounds

key_facts.fact: On the elliptic-curve point-addition task Claude worked for 53 hours with minimal human input and found a new approach to modular inversion; a separate result made the costliest step of a leading quantum optimization algorithm about 12x cheaper.
key_facts.excerpt: After working for 53 hours with minimal human input... Claude arrived at a completely new approach to the problem... The second makes the costliest step of a leading quantum optimization algorithm about 12x cheaper.

key_facts.fact: The headline elliptic-curve result was a 17-fold reduction in gate count at the cost of 12% more qubits; on seven of eight tasks it cut both qubits and Toffoli gates.
key_facts.excerpt: The headline result is a 17-fold reduction in gate count on an elliptic-curve circuit, at the cost of 12% more qubits.

key_facts.fact: The work was led by Andi Gu of Anthropic's STEM Fellows Program with Harvard's Susanne Yelin and Mikhail Lukin, co-founder of QuEra Computing.
key_facts.excerpt: The research team included Andi Gu, of Anthropic's STEM Fellows Program and Harvard; Alek H. Kemeny, of Anthropic and Susanne F. Yelin and Mikhail D. Lukin... Lukin is also co-founder and Chief Scientist of QuEra Computing.

stories.headline: Samsung to make Nvidia's custom HBM base dies on rival TSMC's 3nm process, report says

key_facts.fact: Samsung will build the base die for Nvidia's custom high-bandwidth memory (NVHBM) on TSMC's 3nm process, Seoul Economic Daily reported October 18 citing industry sources; it would be Samsung's first collaboration with TSMC at the HBM manufacturing stage.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung will make the base dies for NVIDIA's custom high-bandwidth memory (HBM) on TSMC's 3nm process, Seoul Economic Daily reports, citing industry sources. It would be the first time Samsung has teamed up with TSMC at the HBM manufacturing stage.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia asked all three HBM suppliers, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron, to use TSMC 3nm for NVHBM base dies and sixth-generation (1c) DRAM for the core dies, so memory performs consistently across suppliers.
key_facts.excerpt: It asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to build NVHBM base dies on TSMC's 3nm and to standardize the DRAM layers above on the sixth-generation process, 1c.

key_facts.fact: NVHBM moves the memory controller from the GPU onto the base die; Nvidia claims up to 30% more bandwidth and 15% lower power than standard HBM4E, with the physical layer shrunk 60%.
key_facts.excerpt: The redesign lets NVHBM widen memory bandwidth by up to 30% and cut power use by 15% against standard HBM4E, the seventh generation. To fit the controller, the physical layer was shrunk by 60%.

key_facts.fact: Industry estimates put TSMC 3nm yield above 90% versus around 60% for Samsung Foundry's comparable 2nm (SF2) process.
key_facts.excerpt: 업계에서는 TSMC 3나노의 수율을 90% 이상으로, 이에 대응하는 삼성 파운드리 2나노(SF2) 공정은 60% 안팎으로 보고 있다.

key_facts.fact: UBS projects 2027 HBM demand at about 61.5 billion gigabits (up 91%) versus new shipments of 54.6 billion gigabits, a roughly 10% shortfall.
key_facts.excerpt: 투자은행 UBS에 따르면 내년 HBM 수요는 비트(저장용량 단위) 기준 약 615억 Gb(기가비트)로 올해보다 91% 늘어날 것으로 전망된다. 반면 메모리 업체들의 신규 출하량은 546억 Gb에 그칠 것으로 예상돼 수요 대비 10%가량 공급 부족이 우려되는 상황이다.

key_facts.fact: Samsung keeps in-house production for standard HBM and custom HBM for other customers such as AMD, and is evaluating whether its own foundry could make NVHBM base dies if demand outgrows TSMC capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: The in-house model stays for standard HBM and for custom HBM for other customers, including AMD. Samsung is also checking whether its own foundry can make NVHBM base dies

key_facts.fact: The report rests on unnamed industry sources, not company statements, and names no chip, start date or volume.
key_facts.excerpt: The report rests on unnamed industry sources, not the companies, and names no chip, start date or volume.

stories.headline: China proposes export bans and curbs on 40 technologies spanning AI, chip design and solar

key_facts.fact: On October 16, China's Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology published a draft revision of the catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export, adding 40 technologies in AI, biomedicine and photovoltaics.
key_facts.excerpt: 此次公开征求意见涉及人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域40项技术。人工智能领域包括大模型、智能体、算力集群、信息处理相关23项技术

key_facts.fact: 14 technologies would be banned from export and 26 restricted; the 23 AI items cover large models, agents, computing clusters and information processing, including AI chip design, while technologies already open-sourced or published are excluded.
key_facts.excerpt: banning 14 and restricting 26... They include technologies for using AI to generate and modify malicious code, AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, core LLM technologies, and AI chip design. Technologies already in the public domain through open-source releases, academic papers, or other means would be excluded.

key_facts.fact: Automatic licensing would apply to cases such as Chinese firms running their own overseas data centers and chip tape-out and fabrication conducted abroad; offering model access via API, apps or SaaS falls outside the controls.
key_facts.excerpt: Facilitation measures, including automatic licensing, could apply to open-source tech exports, Chinese firms setting up and running their own overseas data centers, chip tape-out and fabrication conducted abroad... Providing access through application programming interface calls, apps, website interactions, and software-as-a-service applications... would fall outside the scope

key_facts.fact: Exporters must register listed technologies before export starting October 16, with public comments open until November 15.
key_facts.excerpt: 公众可在2026年10月16日-11月15日期间... 自本公告发布之日起... 技术出口经营者在出口本公告附件所列技术前，应当在商务部业务系统统一平台技术贸易管理信息应用登记。

key_facts.fact: A commerce ministry spokesperson called the move 'necessary' and cited national security; AP noted the technology race with the US is intensifying.
key_facts.excerpt: A spokesperson from the commerce ministry said in a statement that the move was "necessary" and cited national security as one of the reasons.

key_facts.fact: Separately, Taiwan's Economic Affairs Minister Kung Ming-hsin told Bloomberg (published October 16) that Taiwan will add AI servers and cutting-edge chips to its export control list, making unlicensed shipments to China a crime under the Foreign Trade Act, without giving a start date.
key_facts.excerpt: Taipei plans to add artificial intelligence servers and cutting-edge semiconductors to a list of controlled items, Taiwan's Minister of Economic Affairs Kung Ming-hsin told Bloomberg News. After the measures take effect, he said, shipping restricted AI hardware to China will become a criminal offense under the Foreign Trade Act.

key_facts.fact: Violations under Taiwan's Foreign Trade Act can carry up to five years in prison and/or a fine of around $92,500.
key_facts.excerpt: anyone caught smuggling these items will be criminally charged under the Foreign Trade Act, which carries a penalty of up to five years in prison and/or a fine of around $92,500.

stories.headline: Chinese physical-AI chip startup XHEART draws Renault, Chery and CXMT in strategic round

key_facts.excerpt: Mitsubishi Electric will transfer to Lin Yin 50% of its stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility Co., Ltd... The share transfer price is expected to be JPY 115.0 billion.

key_facts.fact: The deal sets an enterprise value of ¥320 billion and equity value of ¥230 billion for the unit, and is expected to close October 1, 2027, pending antitrust approvals.

key_facts.fact: The unit had ¥876 billion in revenue and ¥54 billion in operating profit in the year to March; Mitsubishi Electric expects a roughly ¥100 billion impairment this fiscal year.

stories.headline: French cost-of-living protests turn into nationwide riots; ~1,500 shops looted or damaged

key_facts.fact: On Saturday, October 17, demonstrations across France against rising living costs and declining public services spiralled into some of the worst rioting the country has seen in decades.
key_facts.excerpt: Rioting erupted in cities across France on Saturday as demonstrations against rising living costs and declining public services spiralled out of control in some of the worst violence the country has witnessed for decades.

key_facts.fact: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez put turnout at around 550,000; the CGT union estimated 800,000.
key_facts.excerpt: Around 550,000 people had participated in the demonstrations across the country, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said. The CGT union told Reuters it estimated protesters at 800,000 people.

key_facts.fact: Police arrested about 1,800 people and more than 500 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters were injured, per the BBC citing the interior ministry.
key_facts.excerpt: Police arrested about 1,800 people on Saturday... More than 500 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters were injured in the unrest on Saturday, France's interior ministry said.

key_facts.fact: In Limoges the city hall was set ablaze, in Marseille protesters broke into city hall, and in Lyon the tourist office was torched.
key_facts.excerpt: In Limoges, the city hall was set ablaze; in Marseille, black-clad protesters broke into city hall and defaced the building with anarchic graffiti, and in Lyon, protesters torched the city's tourist office.

key_facts.fact: About 1,500 businesses were hit; Carrefour CEO Alexandre Bompard said 50 Carrefour stores were targeted with repairs over €10 million, and warned the total bill could reach several hundred million euros.
key_facts.excerpt: Bompard... estimated that the unrest had affected around 1,500 businesses nationwide. He warned that the total damage bill could run into several hundred million euros

key_facts.fact: Sephora closed its entire French store network from 5pm Saturday through Sunday; Louis Vuitton, Dior, Celine, Burberry, Lacoste and Apple stores were among those looted or damaged.
key_facts.excerpt: Sephora closed its entire French store network from 5pm on Saturday and kept stores shut on Sunday after several branches were ransacked

key_facts.fact: France 24 notes purchasing power has dwindled since 2024 and fuel prices have soared since the start of the US-Iran war earlier this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Purchasing power in France has dwindled since 2024, while the price of fuel has soared since the start of the US-Iran war earlier this year.

key_facts.fact: President Emmanuel Macron condemned the violence in a televised address on Sunday, promising those responsible for looting would be held accountable.
key_facts.excerpt: President Emmanuel Macron condemned the violence in a televised address on Sunday, promising that those responsible for looting would be held accountable.

stories.headline: Iran says two supertankers hit mines in Hormuz as Brent closes at 5-month high near $110

key_facts.fact: Iran's IRGC said two oil tankers, each carrying about two million barrels of crude, caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz while using a route not authorised by Tehran; the claims were not independently verified.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has said two oil tankers, each carrying about two million barrels of crude oil, caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: UKMTO said at least 10 vessels were attacked in or near the strait in the week since last Sunday, a weekly high since the war began in February, with 23 attacks so far in October.
key_facts.excerpt: at least 10 vessels have been attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz since last Sunday, a weekly high since war broke out in February, and 23 attacks were recorded since the start of the month

key_facts.fact: Kpler data show oil flows through the strait fell from nearly 20.8 million barrels on October 8 to 2.9 million on October 11.
key_facts.excerpt: Nearly 20.8 million barrels of oil passed through on October 8, but only 2.9 million on October 11, according to Kpler data.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude settled at $109.86 on Friday, October 16, its highest close since May 19, while WTI rose 3.5% to $101.41, its first close above $100 since September.
key_facts.excerpt: It ended the week at $109.86 per barrel, still its highest closing level since May 19. U.S. crude oil... jumped 3.5% Friday to close at $101.41 per barrel.

key_facts.fact: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday the strait would reopen on the sixth day if the US meets Iran's seven-day proposal conditions (ending the naval blockade, lifting oil sanctions, ceasefire on all fronts), with talks on the seventh day.
key_facts.excerpt: "If they comply with our conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will reopen on the sixth day, and negotiations will begin on the seventh day," Araghchi said

key_facts.fact: CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper said on October 16 the US naval blockade has prevented at least $25 billion in Iranian crude exports and Washington has frozen nearly $350 million in Iranian crypto assets.
key_facts.excerpt: The US naval blockade of Iran has prevented at least $25 billion in crude oil exports, and Washington has frozen nearly $350 million in Iranian cryptocurrency assets, the commander of US Central Command (CENTCOM) said.

key_facts.fact: Iran's parliament on October 18 approved UN-sanctioned former missile-industry chief Mehrdad Akhlaqi Ketabchi as defense minister, 237 votes to 15.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's parliament on October 18 approved Mehrdad Akhlaqi Ketabchi as the country's new defense minister... He received 237 votes in favor and 15 against

stories.headline: Trump suspends new Russia sanctions law for 60 days, drawing bipartisan backlash and Zelensky's rebuke

key_facts.fact: Trump signed an executive order on Friday, October 16, putting on hold a sweeping Russia sanctions package that he had signed into law, citing the national interest.
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump on Friday signed an executive order that puts on hold a sweeping new sanctions package targeting

key_facts.fact: The blocked sanctions were due to take effect two days later; Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the suspension is a 60-day pause to analyse the impact on the US and global economy.
key_facts.excerpt: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the suspension would consist of a 60-day pause to allow for the Trump administration to analyse the impact

key_facts.fact: The law gave Trump power to levy tariffs of up to 100% on imports from the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas, notably China and India, and sanctioned Putin, Russian banks and the shadow fleet.
key_facts.excerpt: The new US sanctions law took aim at Russia's economy by giving Trump broad powers to levy tariffs of up to 100% on imports from the top five purchasers of Russian oil and gas – most significantly China and India.

key_facts.fact: Republican senators Ted Cruz, John Cornyn and Thom Tillis criticised the move alongside Democrats; Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev called it 'an important and truly historic moment'.
key_facts.excerpt: Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Trump ally, called waiving the sanctions a mistake... John Cornyn called the move "reckless".

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said the decision 'definitely helps only the Russians' and pointed to Russian overnight attacks on 15 Ukrainian energy facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: "The decision to undo all of this, to block all of it, seems wrong to me," Zelenskyy said in a post on X. "And it definitely helps only the Russians."

key_facts.fact: The move follows a Trump-Putin deal easing sanctions so Russia can supply 4.8 million metric tons of diesel to global markets, which experts say will barely move prices.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump's agreement with Putin was for Russia to supply the global market with 4.8 million metric tons of diesel, the equivalent of about ten days of U.S. domestic demand

stories.headline: Nasdaq posts worst week since June as AI-debt fears, $110 oil and 5% yields hit markets

key_facts.fact: On Friday, October 16, the Nasdaq fell 2.1% and ended the week down 4.5%, its worst week since June; the S&P 500 lost 1.1% on the day and about 2% for the week.
key_facts.excerpt: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 finished Friday down a respective 2.1% and 1.2%... The Nasdaq had a four-week winning streak snapped, tumbling 4.5% over the week's five sessions.

key_facts.fact: Tech stocks shed more than $1 trillion in value Friday, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell for an eighth straight day, the longest streak since 2008.
key_facts.excerpt: The Philadelphia semiconductor index dropped 3.8% for its eight straight day of losses, the longest such streak since 2008.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave fell about 12% Friday and roughly 25% for the week, with its bonds selling off to yields above 15% amid worries that debt-laden AI infrastructure firms can't repay as borrowing costs rise.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia-backed CoreWeave slumped 12%, bringing its loss over the past five sessions to about 25%. The data center operator's bonds also sold off sharply this week, pushing yields above 15%.

key_facts.fact: The 10-year Treasury yield traded above 5.09% after spiking to 5.33% on Wednesday's CPI; traders priced an 89% chance of a Fed hike in December after Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at an IMF event in Bangkok.
key_facts.excerpt: The 10-year Treasury yield was above 5.09%... They see an 89% likelihood of a rate hike at its December meeting

key_facts.fact: The VIX rose above 22 for the first time in four months; Bank of America's Michael Hartnett turned 'risk-off' for the next month citing yields, oil and midterm risk.
key_facts.excerpt: The sell-off sent the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) above 22 for the first time in four months.

key_facts.fact: Barclays now expects 25-basis-point Fed hikes in both December and January, after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI readings.
key_facts.excerpt: Barclays now expects 25-basis-point hikes each in December and January.

key_facts.fact: The operators will build ground infrastructure and coordination functions in Europe but will not invest directly in a satellite constellation, which will come from a satellite partner still to be selected.

stories.headline: FDA approves Roche's Enspryng as first at-home injectable treatment for thyroid eye disease

key_facts.fact: Roche announced on October 16 that the FDA approved Enspryng (satralizumab) for adults with thyroid eye disease (TED), the first at-home subcutaneous treatment option.
key_facts.excerpt: Roche... announced today that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Enspryng® (satralizumab) for the treatment of adults with thyroid eye disease (TED), providing patients with the first and only at-home subcutaneous treatment option.

key_facts.fact: Enspryng is a first-in-class anti-IL-6 receptor antibody, dosed every four weeks during maintenance, and can be self-administered or given by a caregiver.
key_facts.excerpt: offering the first at-home SC treatment option every four weeks during maintenance phase

key_facts.fact: In Phase III SatraGO-2, 52.9% of patients on Enspryng achieved a proptosis (eye-bulging) response vs 23.4% on placebo, and 60.7% vs 25.8% saw reduced double vision; SatraGO-1 missed its primary endpoint.
key_facts.excerpt: SatraGO-2 achieved significant and clinically meaningful difference in proptosis response (52.9% in the Enspryng group compared to 23.4% in the placebo group) and in diplopia reduction (60.7%... compared to 25.8%...)

key_facts.fact: TED is a rare autoimmune disease affecting about 155 per 100,000 people in the US; this is Enspryng's second indication after neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder in 2020.
key_facts.excerpt: TED is a rare autoimmune disease affecting approximately 155 out of every 100,000 people in the US
